thesis: The market is risk-off (QQQ below 50/200-day, VIX 1-year percentile 0.877, 10-year yield at a 1-year high), and GCT is a beta 1.6 name with 11.5% of float short, so any drawdown in growth is likely to be amplified. The post-earnings gap has already been paid for, and the last bar was a bearish rejection from the 52-week high of 67.40, with the close at 64.15 about 6% above the SMA20. Reward/risk is only 1.7 and depends on a breakout, because the move to the 67.40 high alone is about 0.8. A 5.3-point stop (1.5 ATR) sits on a swing low that would only be reached by filling the full earnings gap. An executive retirement 8-K was filed on 11/13, with title-only detail, and commentary already calls the rally overbought. Debt of about 476M with debt/equity of 84 adds balance-sheet sensitivity to rates at 5.1%.
